tasks.name: PDP promo block image delivery fix
tasks.notes:
Improve image delivery — .plp-promo-block
PageSpeed flags this image (Collection_faecb378-e4ee-4fc5-8a86-6b2f8666ed28.jpg) inside .plp-promo-block for an est. 6.4 KiB savings on a 28.4 KiB resource. Lighthouse recommends increasing the compression factor to reduce download size, which affects LCP and FCP.
Fix: re-export/compress this image at a higher compression level (lower quality setting, ~70-80% is usually the sweet spot for JPG) without a visible quality loss. If it's served via Shopify's CDN with ?v= params, re-upload the optimized version to the same file so the srcset/sizes attributes don't need to change.
Optionally convert to WebP/AVIF if not already, since Shopify's CDN auto-negotiates format when the source supports it.
